name: Atagabalin
summary: Atagabalin is a drug developed by Pfizer and related to gabapentin, which similarly binds to the α2δ calcium channels (1 and 2). It was under development as a treatment for insomnia, but was discontinued following unsatisfactory trial results. The drug reached phase 2 clinical trials for this indication prior to the discontinuation of its development.

pharmacology.text: Atagabalin (INN, USAN; developmental code name PD-0200390) is a drug developed by Pfizer and related to gabapentin, which similarly binds to the α2δ calcium channels (1 and 2).

summaryZh: PD-200,390（化學名：-[1-(氨基甲基)-3,4-二甲基環戊基]乙酸，或稱為Atagabalin）是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C10H19NO2，由輝瑞公司開發，可結合鈣通道CACNA2D1和CACNA2D2。
summaryZhHans: PD-200,390（化学名：-[1-(氨基甲基)-3,4-二甲基环戊基]乙酸，或称为Atagabalin）是一种含氮有机化合物，分子式C10H19NO2，由辉瑞公司开发，可结合钙通道CACNA2D1和CACNA2D2。

sideEffects.en: It was never marketed, so its effects in people are not well documented. Gabapentinoids as a class cause drowsiness, dizziness, poor coordination and swelling of the legs, and stopping them suddenly after regular use can cause withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 它從未上市，因此對人體的作用紀錄不多。加巴噴丁類作為一類會造成嗜睡、頭暈、協調變差與腿部腫脹，規律使用後突然停藥可能出現戒斷症狀。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它从未上市，因此对人体的作用纪录不多。加巴喷丁类作为一类会造成嗜睡、头晕、协调制差与腿部肿胀，规律使用后突然停药可能出现戒断症状。

fact.en: Like gabapentin and pregabalin, it binds to a helper part of calcium channels in nerve cells rather than to a GABA receptor, despite the family name. Pfizer stopped developing it for insomnia.
fact.zh: 儘管家族名稱如此，它和加巴噴丁、普瑞巴林一樣，是結合神經細胞鈣離子通道的輔助次單元，而非 GABA 受體。輝瑞已停止將它開發為失眠藥物。
fact.zhHans: 尽管家族名称如此，它和加巴喷丁、普瑞巴林一样，是结合神经细胞钙离子信道的辅助次单元，而非 GABA 受体。辉瑞已停止将它开发为失眠药物。
